messages:
mira: quick review request PR #2103 adds 'Midnight' dark theme. goals: tighter code token contrast, chart marker visibility, and a compact theme selector. screenshots attached.

jon: loading now. initial: nice overall. two nits: chart legend at 11px reads soft on panels, and tiny icon buttons lose their focus ring.

asha: code tokens look close: keyword vs builtin are only slightly different. propose keyword #c7a8ff, strings #ffb77a, builtin #7fd1ff. warmer strings help scanning.

kevin: accessibility: axis labels at 12px are ~3.8:1. bump to 14px or increase to --text-primary for >=4.5:1. also make focus ring 3px with alpha'd accent, not pure white.

mira: noted. I'll bump label size and adjust focus ring. also considering a slightly darker inline-code bg for contrast on true-black panels.

jon: charts: on hover, add a subtle halo instead of thickening stroke. keeps default thin lines but improves discoverability.

asha: colorblind check: the heatmap gradient purple->green fails some sims. prefer single-hue sequential (amber->deep-amber) or teal->navy for token frequency.

kevin: copy nit: change toggle from "Enable dark mode" to "Dark theme" with tooltip "Optimized for low-glare reading". consistent with settings language.

mira: updating PR summary: bumped axis text to 14px, adjusted syntax tokens, switched heatmap to amber ramp, added hover halo for chart markers, increased focus ring to 3px, and changed toggle copy. will re-run CI visual-diff.

design-bot: PR #2103 updated by mira (branch/midnight-theme). CI: visual diff report pending.

jon: thanks! will re-review after CI images.

mira: merging after visuals pass :sparkles:
